_comment: English translations of non-English App Store reviews, keyed by review id. The page shows the original with the translation below it, labelled. Reviews without an entry are shown as written.

14623131093.title: Brilliant!
14623131093.body: I enjoy planning my trips with the app :)

14052406038.title: Great app!
14052406038.body: Great app for anyone who loves to travel. As passionate campers we travel to a few countries every year, and with the app we can now keep a travel journal and plan our trips really well.

14040978335.title: Perfect for planning trips and remembering great moments
14040978335.body: Really beautiful visuals, it's great fun to plan your trips and then “tick off” your destinations, and to look back at all the amazing adventures you've already had. I especially love the map view ;)

14032146029.title: Finally a great travel app!!
14032146029.body: I'd been looking for a travel app that meets my expectations for a long time! Absolutely brilliant! I can honestly recommend it to everyone!

14032014652.title: Awesome travel planner
14032014652.body: Really stylish app that also makes you want to plan your next destinations. If you're into collecting points, you'll love it :)

13963914279.title: My new favourite app 😍
13963914279.body: Xplore is the app I was missing! Finally I can record everything and plan the next trip. ✨

13942078139.title: Discover. Tick off. Look further.
13942078139.body: An app that sparks wanderlust! Tick off the places you've already been and get inspired for your next adventure

13933045277.title: Motivation to see more!
13933045277.body: I think the app is great for seeing everywhere I've already been and for getting inspired about where I could go next. The information about the countries is great too!

13932640630.title: So helpful!!!
13932640630.body: Really clear and a beautiful design! So much fun 🐠

13932618099.title: Cool
13932618099.body: Fun app for recording everywhere you've been.

13932349026.title: Awesome content
13932349026.body: I love travelling, I love collecting. Perfect match 🎉✌🏻
